meta.app: squad2033-ja2 pixel generator (TexturePacker JSON hash compatible)

directions.note: SW/W/NW reuse SE/E/NE frames mirrored horizontally around the pivot; anchors mirror as x -> -x.

pivot_px.note: pivot = ground contact point (centre of feet/base) in untrimmed source frame; anchors are px offsets from pivot (+x right, +y down).
